topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When the doorbell rang, I was in the middle of unpacking my own things, the scent of new beginnings still lingering in the boxes. I opened the door to find a neatly wrapped package, the box slightly worn, but its label clear and unintentionally nostalgic for an address now mine. As I signed for it, a subtle smile grew, not just from the mistaken delivery, but from the serendipity of it all. It felt like an unwelcome mix-up, yet here I was, suddenly connected to the life that preceded mine. I decided to keep it on the counter, a small monument to the transient nature of homes and the unexpected stories they gather, until I could return it to its rightful owner.
